issues.title: Tidy rendering of "special elements" in existing orders.
issues.body:
We have a _clash_ in our template editing in `My Orders` tab of the the new `Planning channel`:
1. We have designs for templates for the orders
2. Our `ChannelPlanning` data-type includes other data that we want/need for order planning, such as `location` and `start-finish` dates.  These may not be in the template

So, when JSON-Editor tries to display a set of orders, it has to _make-up_ the UI controls for the second block of data.  It's a bit ugly:
![image](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/1108513/197538218-a8187d80-ae77-4c7e-b736-d2841740d098.png)

We could add the special fields to the templates, but things like the points in a polyline would be quite a verbose set of controls.

I'm tempted to do the following:
- when orders are expanded, we display them using custom UI. The custom UI will know how to tidily display our special blocks (title, location, date-time), then display the others (that come from the template) as label-value.  There would be a button to `edit location`, which would make the shapes editable (I can handle this :-) ).
- then, when the player wants to edit some orders, we switch to JSON editor, but strip out the `special` fields.  When the user `saves`, re-insert the `special` fields.

Here is a first attempt at a custom-UI:
![image](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/1108513/197540114-ac3e4e7e-87fe-4d53-915c-6f68012fd5dd.png)

_Hopefully_ we can use some existing `card` component to create the blocks in the image.
